import json
from pathlib import Path
p = Path("/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/outgoing/ethan_bigdata_jobs_20260906_2122.json")

    rem = "、".join(j.get("remote_hits") or [])

    mark = "★" if is_strong else "·"
    print(f"{mark} {j['date']} | {roles}")
    print(f"  {rem} | {j['link']}")
